reviews.title: Are you there?
reviews.text: App hasn’t been updated for well over a year! My paid subscription should be used to fix issues within the app.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: App’s interface is very lackluster and limited in the options you can adjust for. Would not recommend.

reviews.title: The ads make the free version impossible to use
reviews.text: The free version of this app is trash. You have to watch five minutes of an ad you can’t get off your screen and then it won’t even let you save your data. Ridiculous. I refuse to pay since the free version is so bad.

reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.text: I had to delete because whenever I selected “stop fasting” ads constantly popped up so I couldn’t actually save my progress. Whenever I selected the small x the ads continued to run. It was excessive

reviews.title: Disconnect the app from Internet when using
reviews.text: I get you want to push people to your subscription service, that removes ads. Forcing me to play some, probably misleading, mobile game, is NOT the way to do it. When I just want to end my fasting timer and have it count in the app.
